programs.description: A crew that reaches Skull Island to map it, is attacked by a humongous ape. The survivors then regroup to find out more about the ape, the island's natives and underground monsters.
When his family is killed by a notorious gang, Ryan Varett, a former police officer, suits up to seek revenge against the perpetrators.
A soldier and his brother escape into the woods when their city is invaded by North Korean paratroopers. After their father is killed, the brothers form a guerrilla group to fight back.
The host invites prominent personalities and engages them in candid conversations about their personal and professional lives.
Michael Woods, a traveller and a parolee, picks up the wrong rental car to meet his wife which makes him the prime target of a group of corrupt police officers.
In a deadly game orchestrated by President Snowballs, skilled archer Kantmiss Evershot, her lover Dale and tech-savvy ally Peter Malarkey must rely on their wits and skills to survive.
When an ex-convict returns home to solve his sister's murder, the authority forces him to go undercover to help them bust illegal activities at a nightclub.
Gemini said Angel and Rich trade firearms after Angel's release from jail. However, chaos erupts when they storm a lounge and slay a munitions merchant.
Courtney Collins, a single mother, relocates to a rural home with her twin sons. Later, she discovers it's inhabited by malevolent spirits connected to the sinister entity Bughuul.
After a crucial operation goes wrong, IMF Agent Ethan Hunt and his team must work together with a few allies to prevent a nuclear attack.
A crew that reaches Skull Island to map it, is attacked by a humongous ape. The survivors then regroup to find out more about the ape, the island's natives and underground monsters.
After Set, the Egyptian God of darkness, kills his brother and seizes the throne, he enslaves the kingdom. However, a flawed mortal, Bek, and the God of the sky Horus rise to challenge him.
Five students go to the location of the infamous Dyatlov pass incident to make a documentary, but things take a turn for the worse as the secret of what happened there is revealed.
When Shrek and Fiona return from their honeymoon, they are invited by Fiona's parents to celebrate their union. However, trouble invades the paradise when Fiona's father tries to separate the couple.
An underworld prince ignites a war against humanity to conquer Earth. Consequently, Hellboy and his squad must prevent him from unlocking a lethal army.

An earthquake cracks open the bottom of a lake, releasing a prehistoric species of piranha. As sinister events unfold due to the flesh-eating fish, a group of strangers teams up to stop the bloodbath.

Barry Seal is a US pilot who smuggles drugs for the CIA in the 1980s. Later, his secret work gets revealed as part of the Iran-Contra scandal.
After a devastating accident shatters his world, a once-celebrated champion boxer spirals into a destructive abyss. Subsequently, he decides to fight for his daughter and revive his fading career.
Jane, an American girl travelling in Hong Kong, gets into a physical altercation with three robbers where she defends herself. A martial artist, who observes the event, trains her for a competition.
Jack Dwyer and his family move to a country in Southeast Asia. However, a sudden and violent uprising forces them to flee or risk being executed.
Katniss volunteers to replace her sister in a tournament that ends only when one participant remains. Pitted against contestants who have trained for this all their life, she has little to rely on.
When terrorists suddenly invade the White House, police officer John Cale springs into action to protect his daughter and the President of the United States.
Peter Parker faces Electro and his old friend who is dying and looks out for Spider-Man's blood in order to cure himself.
After years of being at odds with each other, the birds and the pigs are forced to work together when a common enemy attempts to drive them away from their homes.
When Warden Hennessey offers Jensen and other prisoners a chance to compete in a weaponised car race, millions watch as these criminals with life sentences race armoured cars to earn their freedom.
When a hacker reveals the identities of Britain's undercover agents, British agent Johnny English springs back into action and must overcome the challenges of modern technology.
Thomas's mundane and depressing life as a video game developer ends when a group of rebels frees him from his world, which turns out to be a new version of the Matrix.
After being granted the divine power of the Egyptian Gods and spending almost 5000 years in a guardhouse, Black Adam is freed and decides to unleash his style of justice on the world.
